briefDescription: You choose three questions, I open your records, tune in and pull a card for each. The most direct way to access what your soul already knows.
includes: Akashic Record reading with card pulls

children.text: You fill in the form below with your full name, a recent photo and the three questions you most want answered, then pay.
I begin your reading within the next two days and send you a short note when I do.
Within seven days you receive a voice note and a PDF, sent to the email you gave me.

name: The Akashic Record Reading

seo.metaDescription: An Akashic Record reading that feels specific to you. [E2E-Author] delivers a voice note and PDF within 7 days. For when you're ready to remember what you carry.

subtitle: Akashic Record Reading
valueProposition: Direct answers from your soul's infinite records
